title: Transportation
description: Learn about different transportation options, safety, and how to make informed decisions about getting around.

blocks.body: In this module, you will learn about transportation options and management. We'll cover different transportation methods, vehicle safety, maintenance, and how to make informed decisions about your transportation needs—all skills that will help you get where you need to go safely and affordably.
You've learned the essentials of transportation. Safe travels!

quiz.question: Which factor should you consider when choosing a transportation method?
options: Cost, time, reliability, environmental impact, and accessibility
quiz.explanation: Choosing the right transportation method involves considering multiple factors: cost, travel time, reliability, environmental impact, and accessibility.

quiz.question: What is the most important safety measure while driving?
options: Wearing a seatbelt, following traffic rules, and staying focused
quiz.explanation: Vehicle safety requires wearing a seatbelt, following traffic rules, staying focused, and avoiding distractions while driving.

quiz.question: Why is regular vehicle maintenance important?
options: It's not necessary—cars never break down
It prevents breakdowns, extends vehicle life, and ensures safety
Only if your car is very old
quiz.explanation: Regular maintenance prevents expensive breakdowns, extends your vehicle's lifespan, and ensures your safety on the road.

quiz.question: What should you evaluate when deciding whether to buy a car?
options: Purchase price, insurance, fuel, maintenance, and how often you'll use it
quiz.explanation: A comprehensive decision about buying a car includes evaluating total costs (purchase, insurance, fuel, maintenance) and frequency of use.
